block-guide:
CORE/SOCIAL-LINKS A row of social network icons. Each icon is a core/social-link block; the server draws the icon, the link and the hidden label, so a social-link is a comment only, with no HTML. MARKUP (checked in the editor)
OPTIONS (on core/social-links) Styles: default (coloured brand circles), "is-style-logos-only", "is-style-pill-shape" — in the comment's className AND on the
    . iconColor / iconBackgroundColor: palette slug, together with iconColorValue / iconBackgroundColorValue (the colour itself). A *Value adds has-icon-color / has-icon-background-color to the
      , written before the style class. size: "has-small-icon-size" | "has-normal-icon-size" | "has-large-icon-size" | "has-huge-icon-size" — also written as a class on the
        , before the others. openInNewTab:true -> every link gets target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow". showLabels:true -> the service name is shown next to the icon (else it is screen-reader text); add has-visible-labels to the
          . layout: {"type":"flex","justifyContent":"left|center|right|space-between"}; writes no class. PITFALLS A social-link without "url" is not shown at all. "service" picks the icon; see core/social-link. CHECK Open the page: every icon shows and points to its address.
